description: Ministry of Transport and Highways - The Motor Traffic (Fees) Regulations No. 04 of 2022 and Shall Come into Force On 18 November 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Highways under the Motor Traffic Act, establishing new fees and charges for vehicle registration, ownership transfers, and related administrative procedures. The content focuses entirely on legal/regulatory matters - creating new subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks for motor traffic administration, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
